environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo Server deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an internal Application Load Balancer (scheme: internal). The ALB resides in private subnets (10.0.128.0/20, 10.0.144.0/20). Upstream connectivity is provided exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service consumed by three known partner VPCs. The ALB security group ingress rules reference the security group attached to the VPC endpoint ENIs (sg-0a3f8e2c1b9d4567f), which itself only permits connections from the partner VPC CIDR ranges (10.100.0.0/16, 10.101.0.0/16, 10.102.0.0/16). There is no internet gateway, NAT gateway, or VPC peering to any public-routable network in the hosting VPC. Route tables for the private subnets contain only local routes and the PrivateLink prefix list. The partner organizations have contractual SLAs limiting request payload sizes and are authenticated via mutual TLS at the endpoint service level. No public DNS record resolves to the ALB.
